Shade Ribbon Tow.name: Shade Ribbon Tow
Shade Ribbon Tow.description: The user draws the shadow under a ledge or inside a dark rubble gap within five meters into a firm black ribbon stiffened with a spine of smoked glass. It lowers one or two people from an upper floor at a safe pace or slides a trapped survivor out of collapsed debris without cutting them; strong light cracks the ribbon's glass spine and drops what it holds, so the user must keep it in shade. Strain: moderate.
